new_jobs.title: Operator & License Owner, Taipei
new_jobs.jd: **Are you passionate about football (soccer) and interested in growing a local football community?** **Stranger Soccer is expanding globally and is looking for an Operator \& License Owner to launch, manage, and grow our football platform in Taipei.** **This is not a conventional management job—it's an opportunity to build and operate your own local football operation while making football more accessible in your city. It's ideal for entrepreneurial individuals who are passionate about the game and driven to create meaningful, lasting impact.** ⚽ **About the Opportunity** As an Operator \& License Owner, you'll lead the growth of Stranger Soccer in Taipei—from building local partnerships and managing operations to growing an active community of players. You'll have the freedom to shape the local operation while benefiting from the systems, expertise, and support of our Singapore headquarters. 💼 **Key Responsibilities** * Launch and grow Stranger Soccer in Taipei * Build partnerships with football venues and secure quality playing locations * Recruit, coordinate, and support Official Hosts and local team members * Drive marketing initiatives to attract players and grow the community * Oversee game operations and deliver an outstanding player experience * Identify opportunities to improve and expand the local operation You'll receive support from our Singapore headquarters, including: * A technology platform for app, payments, and operations * Proven operating systems and processes * Ongoing guidance across operations, marketing, and growth 🎯 **Who We're Looking For** * Passion for football and a strong understanding of the local football community * An entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership * Experience managing operations and delivering measurable results * Background in operations, community management, or customer experience * Strong leadership, communication, and relationship\-building skills 💡 **Why This Opportunity?** * Build and grow Stranger Soccer in your city * Make a lasting impact on the local football community * Lead a growing network of players and Official Hosts * Benefit from the support of an established international brand * Enjoy a performance\-driven opportunity where your success drives your rewards 🌍 **About Stranger Soccer** Stranger Soccer makes playing football simple, flexible, and accessible. Through our mobile app, players can discover nearby games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play. Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates in 10\+ cities worldwide and has hosted over 100,000 games. We're looking for passionate individuals who want to bring this experience to their local communities. 🚀 **Interested in Joining Us?** Visit **www.strangersoccer.com** and explore the **"Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City"** section to learn more. If you're excited to help shape the future of football participation, we'd love to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Global Category Management – Electronics
new_jobs.location: Tamsui District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: **Your Job** The Vice President, Global Category Management – Electronics is an enterprise leadership role accountable for defining and executing Molex's global electronics category strategy. This executive will shape and govern a resilient, innovative, and cost\-competitive supply ecosystem that enables Molex's growth strategy across all five divisions while elevating supplier collaboration, technology alignment, and supply assurance in a fast\-paced global environment. This leader will operate as a strategic partner to the Molex executive team and divisional leadership, driving category decisions that directly influence product competitiveness, time\-to\-market, working capital, risk posture, and profitability. The role requires executive presence, strong external influence with strategic suppliers, and the ability to lead globally through complexity and change. **What You Will Do** \[ Enterprise Category Strategy \& Business Outcomes] * Own and evolve the global electronics category vision, multi\-year strategy, and governance model, ensuring alignment with Molex enterprise priorities, divisional P\&L objectives, and product roadmaps. * Drive measurable outcomes across cost competitiveness, supply continuity, innovation enablement, working capital efficiency, and risk reduction. * Establish category operating mechanisms, executive dashboards, and performance routines to ensure transparency and accountability across the enterprise. \[ Global Supply Base Architecture \& Technology Alignment] * Architect and continuously optimize a world\-class global supply base capable of supporting Molex's scale, technology trajectory, and regional manufacturing footprint. * Lead supplier portfolio design across strategic partnerships, dual/multi\-sourcing, regionalization, and capacity strategies to improve resilience and agility. * Ensure supplier technology roadmaps are proactively aligned with Molex product and platform roadmaps; sponsor executive\-level roadmap reviews and joint innovation planning. \[ Supplier Governance, Performance \& Executive Relationships] * Set and oversee enterprise standards for Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), including segmentation, governance, performance management, and executive escalation paths. * Build and maintain C\-suite\-level relationships with strategic suppliers to influence investment decisions, capacity allocation, quality priorities, and technology collaboration. * Lead strategic supplier engagements including Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), QBRs, joint technology councils, and contract/partnership negotiations. \[ Cross\-Functional Enterprise Leadership] * Partner across Business Units, Engineering, R\&D, Product Management, Operations, Quality, Finance, Legal, and Risk to ensure category decisions optimize total enterprise value. * Sponsor and govern the Preferred Supplier List (PSL) and Approved Parts List (APL) framework, ensuring compliance, risk management, and technical qualification rigor. * Drive enterprise alignment on standardization opportunities, platform strategies, and design\-to\-value initiatives. \[ New Product Development (NPD), New Product Introduction (NPI) \& Value Engineering] * Institutionalize early supplier involvement (ESI) to accelerate innovation, reduce time\-to\-market, and optimize cost structures at design inception. * Lead enterprise\-wide efforts to deliver ongoing cost and value improvements through value engineering, should\-cost analysis, specification optimization, and multi\-source strategies. * Ensure category strategy supports NPD/NPI ramps, mass production continuity, and end\-of\-life transitions with minimal disruption. \[ Market Intelligence, Risk Management \& Scenario Planning] * Maintain deep expertise in the electronics and semiconductor landscape; build a forward\-looking capability that identifies market shifts, supply constraints, geopolitical risks, and technology inflections. * Lead scenario planning and risk mitigation strategies (e.g., allocation management, capacity reservation, inventory posture, alternate qualification, regional supply strategies). * Provide executive\-ready insights that inform enterprise decisions regarding investment, technology direction, and supplier partnerships. \[ Transformation \& Operating Model Excellence] * Act as a transformational leader driving process modernization, digital enablement, and best\-practice adoption across category management. * Identify and implement improvements that elevate performance in speed, governance, compliance, and value delivery, benchmarking externally against best\-in\-class peers. \[ Executive Communications \& Thought Leadership] * Serve as an executive spokesperson for Molex in relevant supplier, industry, and ecosystem forums when appropriate. * Publish and present a quarterly executive category briefing to senior leadership summarizing market dynamics, supplier health, risk outlook, and strategic actions. \[ Leadership Scope] * Lead, coach, and develop a global electronics category organization, including succession planning and capability building. * Build a high\-performance culture across regions and functions in a matrixed environment, setting clear expectations and enabling accountability. **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field. * 15\+ years of progressive leadership experience across global procurement/category management, strategic sourcing, and/or engineering within electronics. * Demonstrated executive ownership of complex, global categories with significant spend and supplier complexity. * Proven track record leading high\-stakes negotiations and contracting (pricing, supply agreements, LTAs, capacity reservations, IP/technology collaborations, and risk/commercial terms). * Strong understanding of electronics and semiconductor ecosystems, market dynamics, production processes, and sourcing strategies. * Proven ability to influence and drive alignment across executive stakeholders in a matrixed, global organization. **What Will Put You Ahead** * Master's degree (MBA, MS Engineering, or equivalent) strongly preferred. * Demonstrated success building and leading global, high\-performing category teams and operating models. * Experience shaping enterprise procurement strategies supporting: Optical module architecture, active electrical cables, passive optical components, and automotive systems. Next\-generation bandwidth platforms (400G, 800G, 1\.6T). Datacenter and optical network component technologies (silicon photonics, laser diodes, PICs, co\-packaged optics, isolators, optical DSP). Advanced automotive electronics systems and architecture. * Experience leading through disruption (e.g., allocation environments, major supply constraints, geopolitical shocks, rapid demand swings). * Enterprise strategy leadership: Ability to translate market and technology signals into actionable, value\-creating category strategies. * Executive presence and influence: Credible with C\-suite stakeholders internally and externally; able to lead through persuasion and governance. * Transformational change leadership: Proven ability to modernize processes, adopt new operating models, and sustain change. * Global leadership: Builds inclusive, high\-performance teams across cultures, time zones, and matrixed structures. * Commercial excellence: Advanced negotiation, contracting, and total cost/value modeling capabilities. * Technical and business fluency: Can engage deeply with engineering specifications while maintaining enterprise\-level commercial focus. * Risk management mindset: Proactive scenario planning, mitigation design, and crisis leadership. * Communication excellence: Strong executive\-level written and verbal communication; capable of board\-ready synthesis and storytelling. *At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewar

new_jobs.title: National Marketing Manager
new_jobs.jd: Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. **Essential Duties And Responsibilities** * Develop and execute strategic marketing plans, brand strategies, go\-to\-market plans, and market development programs aligned with business objectives for assigned therapies and products. * Evaluate market segments, treatment trends, customer journeys, unmet customer needs, reimbursement dynamics, policy developments, and competitive intelligence to identify growth opportunities and business risks. * Define product, therapy, and portfolio positioning strategies, including value proposition, messaging, branding direction, sales tools, HCP education content, and customer engagement priorities. * Lead integrated online and offline marketing programs to support patient acquisition, patient retention, therapy awareness, healthcare professional education, and patient association engagement where applicable. * Apply digital and AI\-enabled tools to enhance marketing analysis, marketing effectiveness, campaign efficiency, customer engagement, content development, segmentation, performance tracking, and insight generation. * Leverage data analytics, CRM insights, digital dashboards, market research, and defined KPIs to monitor campaign performance, identify market signals, and translate insights into timely actions and optimized business decisions. * Lead policy\-to\-hospital tracking and execution by monitoring relevant healthcare policy, reimbursement, and access developments; mapping implications by hospital/account; aligning internal stakeholders; and ensuring disciplined follow\-through with field teams. * Work closely with Sales, Medical Affairs, Government Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Supply Chain, regional/global marketing, and other support functions to coordinate execution and influence favorable market development outcomes. * Build and manage strong relationships with KOLs, professional societies, patient associations, hospital stakeholders, government\-related stakeholders, industry partners, and relevant external organizations to support therapy adoption and market shaping. * Support pricing, reimbursement, and access strategy by integrating market insights, customer value, competitive landscape, policy signals, and financial analysis into clear business recommendations. * Lead key strategic projects and cross\-functional initiatives, including market research, digital platforms, AI\-enabled marketing pilots, hospital\-level implementation tracking, policy\-shaping initiatives, and transform policy to drive account execution. * Plan and execute marketing activities within the approved operating expense level, ensuring compliant execution, effective resource allocation, milestone tracking, and measurable business impact. * Own disciplined project management for key initiatives by defining clear milestones, timelines, KPIs, owners, follow\-up mechanisms, and regular progress reviews to ensure on\-time and on\-target delivery. **Qualifications** * To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily and demonstrate strong business ownership, strategic thinking, analytical capability, stakeholder influence, and execution discipline. * Strong understanding of healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, or therapy\-based market dynamics, including hospital decision\-making, reimbursement, and access considerations. * Hands\-on experience or strong interest in applying AI\-enabled tools to enhance marketing effectiveness, content development, customer engagement, productivity, and performance optimization. * Strong results orientation, commercial acumen, ownership mindset, collaboration, execution excellence, and experience in policy shaping or policy\-related market development initiatives. * Fluent English communication skills, both spoken and written. Education and/or Experience * Bachelor’s degree required; degree in business, marketing, pharmacy, science, healthcare, or related field preferred. * MBA or equivalent business education strongly preferred. * Minimum 8–10 years of experience in healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, or related industry, including at least 3 years of people management experience. * Experience in therapy development, reimbursement/access strategy, policy\-related execution, KOL management, patient programs, digital/AI\-enabled marketing, or cross\-functional commercial initiatives is strongly preferred. * Prior experience working with regional or global teams is a plus. **Reasonable Accommodation** Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link **Recruitment Fraud Notice** Vantive has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Vantive employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

new_jobs.title: Algorithm Engineer
new_jobs.jd: **Company Overview** KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. **Group/Division** With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Broadband Plasma Division (BBP) provides market\-leading patterned wafer optical inspection systems for leading\-edge IC manufacturing. Logic, foundry, and memory customers depend on BBP products to detect yield\-critical defects for process debug and excursion monitoring at advanced process nodes. BBP flagship products include the 29xx and 39xx series which leverage Broadband Plasma technology to capture a wide range of defects with ultimate sensitivity at the optical inspection speeds needed for inline defect monitoring. **Responsibilities** **Job Description/Preferred Qualifications** Job responsibilities of this position include: Provide algorithm technical support for escalations in various of product life cycle phases onsite. Interacting with TSMC business unit, GSS (Global Service Support) and customers to address issues and investigate solutions. Analyzing the signal and noise characteristics of current and emerging IC yield limiting defects, formulating algorithmic solutions, and validating them via simulation and prototyping. Investigating feasibility of advance algorithm for next generation product through collaboration with technology and system architect group. Provide prototype algorithm solution for special customer engagement project at customer site. Working with product system engineering team to define the algorithm performance specification and use it to guide the algorithm design and implementation. Act as the algorithm representative during system level hardware/software integration, trouble shooting. Participate in software quality assurance activities required by the software development process. Occasional (\<\=5%) travel to HQ is required **Preferred Qualifications** Qualifications: Strong problem analysis and solving skills Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies Solid theoretical background in signal/image processing and computer vision Research and/or software development experience on Unix/Linux and Windows platform. Proficient in C/C\+\+, solid CUDA programming skills. Must be an effective communicator able to share technical information with functional teams and provide executive level reports to management and customers. Throughput optimization experience is desired. **Minimum Qualifications** Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience or Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years *We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.* *KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer* Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.
